technical-summary: Campaign arms start the radiance engine and helpers from a serving manifest: an arm's serving block (layout, settings, heat inputs, optional calibration store, live policy, experiment) is turned into a measured manifest by radiance_plan (bc-serve write-manifest, plan-cache miss measured like the launcher), the engine starts as --manifest M --role engine, and quality arms run the KL mode from the manifest (rad0009 lets the four --kld flags accompany --manifest). BC_SERVING_MANIFEST and the R3_MOE_WORKER_* arm settings are removed; 55 unrunnable or unreferenced job files and drivers are archived and seven jobs migrated to serving blocks.
user-summary-candidate: Benchmark and quality campaigns for radiance now describe each arm as a serving configuration and run from the same manifest the engine uses, instead of raw flags and environment variables.
